title: Dark Ritual
narrativeText: The lights go out completely. When they return — red. Daemon stands in the center of the ring, arms spread, head back. No opponent has answered the call tonight. One of them will regret that.

choices.label: Summon the Challenge
choices.text: The darkness answers. An opponent steps forward — or is dragged forward.

title: Lights Out
narrativeText: Daemon reaches into the circuit breaker panel behind the curtain and kills the main lights. The building goes completely dark. The crowd screams — not in fear, in anticipation. When the emergency lighting flickers on (dim, red-tinged), Daemon is already in the ring.

choices.label: Fight in the Dark
choices.text: Your opponent can't see you. You don't need to see them.
